measurementScope: owned process on a separate inactive desktop; repeated samples after observed HWND responsiveness
limitations: 測定完了は性能予算の合格を意味しない
別desktopでトレイが使えず常駐が起動しない場合は失敗として記録する
SettingsのUIAなし・ありは同じソース/ビルド条件のexeを明示する。ソース同一性はharnessから推定しない
CPU背景負荷・キャッシュ・電源状態は操作しない
実マイク・HUD稼働・入力遅延・貼付・実画面品質は測定しない

worker-result.scope: owned app process on an inactive desktop; helper, speech and other processes excluded
limitations: Inactive desktop idle is not interactive desktop or active HUD performance.
Startup ends at an observed responsive HWND, not first visible pixels or recognition readiness.
Warmup is a fixed excluded observation after responsiveness, not proof of asynchronous completion.
UIA activation includes provider initialization. Expected absence requires the full bounded observation window.
No keyboard, microphone, speech recognition, paste, screenshot or external API operation is invoked.
CPU load, caches and power settings are not controlled; repetitions and order are recorded.

jobBaseline.rule: Before any app launch: own worker and job-member System32 conhost created no earlier than the worker. Later boundaries allow only these exact PID/creation-time/image identities; console hosts may exit.

difference.scope: after the explicit UIA probe; expected feature-off absence is not accessibility success

proposedBudget.requires: same-source/profile builds differing only in official accessibility feature; supplied by caller
